User.title: User
User.description: User profile and permission role in NannyPay

role.description: Access role: admin (manage all + users), editor (super user: add/edit shifts & rates), viewer (read only)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user was first registered

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user was last updated

AppSetting.title: AppSetting
AppSetting.description: Global application settings such as current default hourly rate

currentHourlyRate.description: The active hourly rate in effect for future shifts

currency.description: Currency symbol or code (e.g. $, MXN, USD, EUR)

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the settings were last updated

updatedBy.description: Email of the user who updated the settings

Shift.title: Shift
Shift.description: Daily work record for the nanny with frozen rate at time of creation

hourlyRate.description: Frozen hourly rate applied to this specific day

totalAmount.description: Calculated pay for this day (hoursWorked * hourlyRate)

nannyName.description: Name of the nanny for this shift

notes.description: Optional notes or comments about the shift

status.description: Payment status: pending deposit or paid

paidAt.description: Timestamp when the shift was paid or deposited

weekKey.description: Key representing the week (e.g. 2026-W37 or Monday date YYYY-MM-DD) for fast weekly grouping

createdBy.description: User email who logged this shift

/users/{userId}.description: Collection of user roles and profiles
